design: Identity A->A,B->B versus swap A->B,B->A, each with both entry orders and both query names. Same name frequencies and local query syntax; record exact positions.
hypotheses: A source-role query suppressor stays suppressive under identity mappings even though query identity is then correct.
A mapped-value reader copies the demonstrated target across identity/swap mappings.
Midpoint neutralization harms correct mapped-value evidence, while neutralizing query suppression can help identity mappings and hurt swap mappings.
scope: One source position, one head, final attention destination; other paths and downstream computation live. This is not whole-circuit ablation.
selection: All eight name pairs, four mapping/order cells, all heads/sites, no fits or postselection. Native competence reported first.
precision: float32 computation after shared-loader bfloat16 rounding
